purpose: A short reusable Blender pilot that can be extended into a full original Tiny Tales music, colour and pattern story.

concept.hero: Milo, an original warm orange-red panda child musician with a cream muzzle, dark ears and a striped tail.
concept.world: A colourful twilight garden stage with three glowing mushroom drums, modular flowers, rounded trees, firefly lights and a circular grass platform.
concept.pilot_action: Milo anticipates and taps the blue, golden and pink mushroom drums in sequence; each musical hit makes the matching flower bloom before Milo finishes in a welcoming performance pose.
concept.full_episode_extension: Expand to six garden zones that teach colour, high/low sound, copy-the-pattern rhythm, turn-taking and an original final garden song.

motion_direction.emotional_intent: curiosity grows into musical delight and a warm invitation to join in
motion_direction.visual_narrative: establish Milo and the sleeping garden, build through three cause-and-effect beats, then resolve on the fully blooming stage
motion_direction.hero_motion: Milo's arm anticipation, clear drum strike, body bounce and settled final pose
motion_direction.support_motion: drum-cap squash and three staggered flower blooms
motion_direction.ambient_motion: slow firefly drift and restrained leaf sway
motion_direction.camera: one eased push-in only; no pan, orbit, shake or reframing
motion_direction.restraint: only one drum and one flower receive the primary action on each beat

composition.focal_point: Milo's face and active drum sit around the centre/right-thirds power area

layers.background: twilight world, moon, rounded trees and distant flowers
layers.foreground: soft grass tufts and near flowers for depth

reusable_scene_contract.character_controller: MILO_CTRL with separately named body, head, arm and tail controls
reusable_scene_contract.material_family: named Tiny Tales matte, cream, dark, glow and foliage materials

acceptance_checks: Milo remains recognizable and anatomically stable throughout.
Each drum strike has visible anticipation, contact, squash and recovery.
The corresponding flower begins blooming only after its matching strike.
The three major hit frames align with audible percussion transients.
The camera performs one smooth push without orbit, shake or abrupt reframing.
The scene ends on a stable pose with all three flowers open.
The output fully decodes as H.264 video with AAC stereo audio.
All critical character features remain inside the five-percent safe area.
